LanguageData.DreamAbandonedMaze.label: Dreamt about abandoned maze
LanguageData.DreamAbandonedMaze.description: I wandered around a labyrinth of rooms and hallways made up of my childhood home and locations I had previously visited, like my school and my friend's and family's houses. Everything was in black and white, and I had the feeling of being followed, or even chased at times. The rooms always looked run down, like they had been abandoned...
LanguageData.DreamAbandonedMaze.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamArrakisVision.label: Dreamt about girl on desert planet
LanguageData.DreamArrakisVision.description: The planet was being ravaged by outsiders, its resources stolen and people enslaved. She stood among sparkling gusts of sand and reached out for me to help defend her home. But I did not know her, or the world she was from. And in the end, we both were were swallowed by the sand, reddened by the blood of her people...
LanguageData.DreamArrakisVision.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamBanditCowboy.label: Dreamt about bandit cowboy
LanguageData.DreamBanditCowboy.description: A cowboy called us on the radio. The entire colony gathered to chat with him. Half were charmed by his outlandish tales, half felt he was sketchy. He wanted to join us, along with his giant boomalope. After a long discussion, he was refused, but he still insisted on passing through the colony. He led the boomalope through our fields and when he was in the middle of our crops, near the windmills... he released the 'lope and ran like hell. Then came the bandits. He was part of the bandits... and the boomalope exploding was the sign for the attack.
LanguageData.DreamBanditCowboy.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamBeingChased.label: Dreamt about being chased
LanguageData.DreamBeingChased.description: Something was chasing me but I couldn't run!
LanguageData.DreamBeingChased.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamCannibalismBad.label: Dreamt about eating humans
LanguageData.DreamCannibalismBad.description: I was forced to eat someone in my dream. It was an awful experience...
LanguageData.DreamCannibalismBad.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamChildhoodBad.label: Dreamt about childhood
LanguageData.DreamChildhoodBad.description: I relived some of the worst moments from my childhood.
LanguageData.DreamChildhoodBad.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamCorpsesPile.label: Dreamt about pile of corpses
LanguageData.DreamCorpsesPile.description: I was lying on a huge pile of human corpses , some rotten, some fresh. I couldn't move. It was some kind of cargo section inside of a ship in the ocean. From the pile crawled a rotten corpse and grabbed my feet and bit off some toes. It crawled closer and tried to bite... well... that place... I woke up with pain in that place...
LanguageData.DreamCorpsesPile.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamDarkFigures.label: Dreamt about dark figures
LanguageData.DreamDarkFigures.description: I was wandering around the colony when I saw a shadowy figure coming out of a dark corner. I asked it what it wants, but it didn't respond. The figure approached me, coming closer and closer with each second. I panicked, the fear paralysed me. Then another figure appeared behind me. After that, the figures grabbed me by my legs and arms. I screamed and everything went dark.
LanguageData.DreamDarkFigures.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamDistantDanger.label: Dreamt about distant danger
LanguageData.DreamDistantDanger.description: I had a dream in which I walked around the colony. After a few moments I realised that my head was rolling down the hill away from our home. I chased it until it stopped. After finally regaining my precious head, I looked around. Everything was burned to the ground and the only sounds were coming from strange machinery spitting out ancient mechanoids...
LanguageData.DreamDistantDanger.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamDistantDangerTribal.label: Dreamt about distant danger
LanguageData.DreamDistantDangerTribal.description: I had a dream in which I walked around the village. After a few moments I realised that my head was rolling down the hill away from our home. I chased it until it stopped. After finally regaining my precious head, I looked around. Everything was burned to the ground and the only sounds were coming from strange machinery spitting out blood machines...
LanguageData.DreamDontRemember.label: Can't recall a bad dream
LanguageData.DreamDontRemember.description: I dreamt about something upsetting but I don't really remember what it was...
LanguageData.DreamDontRemember.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamEatenBySnake.label: Dreamt about being devoured by snake
LanguageData.DreamEatenBySnake.description: I was slowly being devoured by a gigantic snake!
LanguageData.DreamEatenBySnake.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamExPartner.label: Dreamt about my ex partner
LanguageData.DreamExPartner.description: I don't want you back in my life! Stop bothering me in my sleep!
LanguageData.DreamExPartner.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamFed.label: Dreamt about starvation
LanguageData.DreamFed.description: I was starving... I begged people to help me... But they wouldn't!
LanguageData.DreamFed.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamFightingZombies.label: Dreamt about fighting zombies
LanguageData.DreamFightingZombies.description: Our group had to defend against zombies using some ancient non-lethal weaponry. Why would you even use non-lethal weapons?!
LanguageData.DreamFlamingoInvasion.label: Dreamt about flamingos invasion
LanguageData.DreamFlamingoInvasion.description: The world got invaded by pink birds. The birds had kevlar helmets, assault rifles, demonic red eyes, and they were sometimes doing drill movements.
LanguageData.DreamFlamingoInvasionTribal.label: Dreamt about flamingos invasion
LanguageData.DreamFlamingoInvasionTribal.description: The world got invaded by pink birds. The birds had inpenetrable by our weapons armour. They were practicing odd war tactics.
LanguageData.DreamFriendTripFight.label: Dreamt about fight among friends
LanguageData.DreamFriendTripFight.description: Me and my best friend met in front of their house. We wanted to go biking together, and so we did. We were biking around many different places. When we were finally coming back home we saw a bunch of alligators climbing on a fence next to us. Scared, we rode away as fast as we could. After some time it got really cold outside, so we stopped under someone's house so we could dress up into heavier clothes. Suddenly, out of nowhere, a tank appeared and shot at us. My friend escaped with their bike, leaving me alone. Sometime later I woke up at a house. It was the same house we stopped at to dress up. An old man was the owner and he was actually nice. My phone's battery was completely dead though. I wanted to go back home with my bike, but it was in pieces and some were missing. I walked home to tell my parents what happened. When I came back for my bike my other friends were taking it apart for parts. I had to fight them for my bike.
LanguageData.DreamGettingExecuted.label: Dreamt about being executed
LanguageData.DreamGettingExecuted.description: My head rolled on the ground for a long time after being swiftly disconnected from my body... I couldn't catch my breath... This guilt is killing me!
LanguageData.DreamImprisoned.label: Dreamt about being in prison
LanguageData.DreamImprisoned.description: I asked them to let me out... I was innocent...
LanguageData.DreamImprisoned.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamInjury.label: Dreamt about injury
LanguageData.DreamInjury.description: I had wounds all over my body. Someone hurt me pretty badly but I managed to escape.
LanguageData.DreamInjury.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamInsectsBad.label: Dreamt about insects
LanguageData.DreamInsectsBad.description: They were crawling everywhere. Millions of bugs and worms were chasing me. At least I woke up the moment they got me...
LanguageData.DreamInsectsBad.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamJarception.label: Dreamt about brain in a jar
LanguageData.DreamJarception.description: I was in the middle of some kind of secret archotech laboratory. All surfaces were sterile and perfectly clean. I explored the place for a while until I reached a warehouse which looked like it was hundreds of miles long. On every shelf there was a jar with a brain, connected to a screen. I watched what was happening on those screens... Someone was cooking a meal... Someone else was chased by gangsters... Another person got some lovin'... but then I saw a truly extraordinary screen. It showed the perspective of a man in a huge warehouse filled with jars with brains...
LanguageData.DreamJarception.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamKillingFavoriteAnimal.label: Dreamt about killing my favourite animal
LanguageData.DreamKillingFavoriteAnimal.description: I had to kill my pet by strangling it, I was squeezing its throat with both hands and it wouldn't die and just kept looking at me with its big soft eyes. I was sobbing uncontrollably in the dream but I had to just keep trying to kill it.
LanguageData.DreamKittenCollecting.label: Dreamt about kittens
LanguageData.DreamKittenCollecting.description: There was a litter of kittens spread throughout our home. I knew I was dreaming, but I also knew I had to collect all the kittens before something bad happened. Somehow, I could not just wake up. I tried to gather the kittens, but dropped them or lost them whenever I thought I was done. I ran through the rooms, desperate and scared, but couldn't find all of them.
LanguageData.DreamLittleDwarf.label: Dreamt about a little dwarf
LanguageData.DreamLittleDwarf.description: I dreamt I walked around the forest with my friend and a little dwarf ambushed us and stabbed them with a tiny knife!
LanguageData.DreamLittleDwarf.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamMazeEscape.label: Dreamt about escaping a maze
LanguageData.DreamMazeEscape.description: I was running on what looked like hard packed dirt with little bits of gravel and grass. As I ran I would often times have to make decisions on where to run, left or right, because the walls that blocked the way were clown and doll heads. I had to run a maze that was made out of a clown and doll head, while something chased me. I woke up and was in a dry sweat and didn't want to open my eyes at all.
LanguageData.DreamMazeEscape.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamMeatLocker.label: Dreamt about meat locker
LanguageData.DreamMeatLocker.description: I was exploring the colony in the dark when I stumbled into the freezer. I saw shapes in the heavy mist hanging on meat hooks, and when I drew close I saw that they were human. They reached for me and I tried to turn away but there were more behind me, possessing the faces of people we have killed. They grabbed me and lifted me onto a hook to stay there with them for all eternity...
LanguageData.DreamMeatLocker.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamMindControl.label: Dreamt about being mind controlled
LanguageData.DreamMindControl.description: People around me were getting injected with mind control drugs forcefully.
LanguageData.DreamMindControl.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamMoonCrash.label: Dreamt about moon crash
LanguageData.DreamMoonCrash.description: I awoke in my room. Felt a bit thirsty so I went to the kitchen to drink some water. Went outside to get some fresh air and there was an enormous moon up in the sky. Everything was shaking, almost like an earthquake was terrorizing the area. Orange light illuminated the surroundings. Buildings were floating here and there, like gravity had been turned off. The Moon came closer. The shaking got stronger. I heard screaming. Then some odd force hit me and I collapsed.
LanguageData.DreamMoonCrash.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamMurderBad.label: Dreamt about killing
LanguageData.DreamMurderBad.description: I killed without mercy... But I didn't want to...
LanguageData.DreamMurderBad.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamMurderingCloseOne.label: Dreamt about killing a close one
LanguageData.DreamMurderingCloseOne.description: I killed a person close to me in my dream. I didn't want to!
LanguageData.DreamNudeBad.label: Dreamt about being nude
LanguageData.DreamNudeBad.description: I was walking around our colony, when I realised that I'm wearing no clothes! I felt so embarrassed when everyone started laughing at me!
LanguageData.DreamNudeBad.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamOrganSteal.label: Dreamt about surgery
LanguageData.DreamOrganSteal.description: Please, no! Don't take my organs...
LanguageData.DreamOrganSteal.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamPastEvent.label: Dreamt about event from the past
LanguageData.DreamPastEvent.description: I had a dream about a stressful event from my past. I would rather not be reminded of it.
LanguageData.DreamPastEvent.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamSevenLives.label: Dreamt about tragic lives and deaths
LanguageData.DreamSevenLives.description: I had to enter 7 tragical lives of people who had 7 tragical deaths. I lived 7 tragic lives and died 7 tragic deaths. 7... 7... 7...
LanguageData.DreamSevenLives.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamSillyThingsBad.label: Dreamt about silly things
LanguageData.DreamSillyThingsBad.description: Dancing nuns, walking sofas, talking plants... I dreamt about weird things, nothing in particular but it didn't feel good.
LanguageData.DreamSillyThingsBad.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamSlavePunishment.label: Dreamt about punishment
LanguageData.DreamSlavePunishment.description: They beat me and starved me. Whatever I did, however I tried to please my captors, I only got pain in reward. The crack of the whip woke me up.
LanguageData.DreamSocialExclusion.label: Dreamt about social exclusion
LanguageData.DreamSocialExclusion.description: I was excluded from my group because I was scared to snort Yayo... Do we even have any Yayo?
LanguageData.DreamStealingHoney.label: Dreamt about stealing honey
LanguageData.DreamStealingHoney.description: I was in some kind of magical forest. After walking a few miles I noticed a big bee hive. I was hungry, so I put my hand in it to snatch some honey but when I took it out there was no honey... only wiggling maggots.
LanguageData.DreamStealingHoney.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamTikiSpider.label: Dreamt about tiki-spider
LanguageData.DreamTikiSpider.description: I was in a humid, foreign jungle, trapped in a long, ancient stone temple hallway. I turned around, and a spider with a tiki mask started chasing me. I woke up just before it pounced...
LanguageData.DreamTikiSpider.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamTornadoFlight.label: Dreamt about tornado
LanguageData.DreamTornadoFlight.description: I had a dream where I was in a brick building and it got hit by a tornado. It pulled the building apart and picked me up into the air! Somehow, I did not get hurt.
LanguageData.DreamTornadoFlight.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamWarhead.label: Dreamt about destruction of colony
LanguageData.DreamWarhead.description: I was walking away from the colony. I felt a strong sense of urgency, that I needed to get away, yet I couldn't figure out why. As I walked up to the hill overlooking the colony , I started to calm. As I reached the top, I sat down upon the grass under the trees and watched calmly as a small figure fell down from the boundless, blue sky. Only then, as the antigrain warhead went off did I understand why I had felt that urgency.
LanguageData.DreamWarhead.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamWarheadTribal.label: Dreamt about destruction of tribe
LanguageData.DreamWarheadTribal.description: I was walking away from the camping grounds. I felt a strong sense of urgency, that I needed to get away, yet I couldn't figure out why. As I walked up to the hill overlooking the tribe, I started to calm. As I reached the top, I sat down upon the grass under the trees and watched calmly as a small figure fell down from the boundless, blue sky. Only then, as the gigantic blood machine went approached did I understand why I had felt that urgency.
LanguageData.DreamWarheadTribal.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamWerewolfMarriage.label: Dreamt about unfortunate marriage
LanguageData.DreamWerewolfMarriage.description: I was in a small church, getting married. My family was sitting on one side of the room, and the other side was where my fiance's family was. The pastor was giving the ceremony, and we were holding hands, looking at each other. At one point, I slowly looked over to both our families. Nothing seemed out of the ordinary. Everything was fine. My family was sitting in the pews, as normal, my fiance's as well. After looking at them, I looked at my fiance. A few seconds later, I looked back at the families, and noticed something odd. My fiance's family had changed into a random menagerie of canines. My family was completely unphased. I look back at my fiance which had turned into a greyish black werewolf, smirking, still holding my hands.
LanguageData.DreamWorldFellApart.label: Dreamt about Armageddon
LanguageData.DreamWorldFellApart.description: I dreamt that the whole world fell apart. It was a disaster.
LanguageData.DreamWorldFellApart.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamZombieTrucks.label: Dreamt about zombie trucks
LanguageData.DreamZombieTrucks.description: I was chased across an arid shrubland by zombified monster trucks that had emerged from a cave in a mountain...
LanguageData.DreamZombieTrucks.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
